legacyRationale.packages/mg_read_runtime/src/desktop-run: Construction-only progress, browser-provider and launch option types moved to desktop-runtime-options.ts. The remaining HTTP, WebSocket, cache/source-content control, shutdown and owner-span state shares ECMAScript private fields; the next split is a cache/source-content dispatch port with protocol characterization.
legacyRationale.packages/mobile_scanner/darwin/mobile_sc: Unmodified mobile_scanner 7.4.0 upstream Darwin implementation vendored with its license while MgRead carries an Android built-in Kotlin build patch. Freeze it at the upstream size; remove this baseline when an upstream release supports built-in Kotlin and the path dependency is retired.
legacyRationale.packages/mg_read_runtime/src/plugin-mana: Icon resources, installation usage and artifact-transfer coordination moved to dedicated modules. Installed activation, development refresh and invocation cancellation still share the single VM queues and AsyncLocalStorage; the next split is an explicit activation port.
